# karmi

> karmi is a code-first TypeScript framework. You use it to build agent harnesses that run natively on a serverless runtime.

The guide shows the public API only. The terms with capitals, for example Thread and Scope, are in the glossary.

## Guide

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/01-getting-started.md): Getting started creates a project, runs its tests and deploys it.
- [Agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/02-agents.md): Agents describes `defineAgent`, instructions, models and Agent Specs as data.
- [Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/03-tools.md): Tools describes `defineTool`, annotations, Provider Tools, Skills and deferred Tools.
- [Threads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/04-threads.md): Threads describes Turns, Approvals, Compaction, forks and offline delivery.
- [Providers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/05-providers.md): Providers describes the Anthropic Provider, the AI SDK Provider and Cloudflare AI Gateway.
- [HTTP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/06-http.md): HTTP describes the REST routes and the event streams.
- [Sandbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/07-sandbox.md): Sandbox describes Scripts, isolation and the container sandbox.
- [Schedules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/08-schedules.md): Schedules describes Schedules, which send an Event to a Thread at a later time.
- [Memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/09-memory.md): Memory describes what the Agents of a Scope remember about a User.
- [Knowledge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/10-knowledge.md): Knowledge describes Knowledge, retrievers, and vector and hybrid retrieval.
- [MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/11-mcp.md): MCP describes remote MCP servers.
- [Credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/12-credentials.md): Credentials describes credential references, the credentials of a Scope and Secrets providers.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/13-testing.md): Testing describes the tests of an agent project.
- [Observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/14-observability.md): Observability describes usage records and logging.
- [Doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/15-doctor.md): Doctor describes `karmi doctor`.
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/docs/guide/16-deployment.md): Deployment describes the deploy to Cloudflare, the bindings, and recovery and time.

## Glossary

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsblabs/karmi/main/CONTEXT.md): The glossary defines each karmi term that the guide uses.
